subject: FTS5 query tokens with hyphens
content: SQLite FTS5 reads a bare hyphen in a MATCH string as a column filter or NOT operator, so a query like "pre-commit" errors or matches nothing. Quote each token before building the MATCH expression.

subject: libkrun virtiofs and file locks
content: Inside a libkrun guest, virtiofs does not support flock across host and guest. Tools that lock a shared cache (cargo, npm) hang when the host also touches it. Give the guest its own cache dir.

subject: vault egress proxy and HTTP/2
content: The vault's egress proxy only speaks HTTP/1.1. Clients that require h2 with prior knowledge (some gRPC stacks) fail with a protocol error, not a policy denial, so the error message misleads.

subject: brief check and uncommitted SIGNOFF
content: brief check --base origin/main reads .brief/SIGNOFF from the commit range, not the working tree. A sign-off line you wrote but did not commit passes locally and then blocks in CI.

subject: Hyperdrive and advisory locks
content: Hyperdrive does not support Postgres advisory locks, so pg_advisory_lock through the gateway silently gives no mutual exclusion. Serialize with a row lock on a guard table instead.

subject: Playwright browser revision in cloud sessions

subject: Hyperliquid unified account balances
content: For unified-margin Hyperliquid accounts, spotClearinghouseState USDC already includes perp margin as `hold`. Adding clearinghouseState accountValue on top double-counts the margin.

subject: forge invariant flags on foundry 1.7

subject: urllib forwards Authorization on redirect
content: Python urllib re-sends every header except Content-* when it follows a redirect, including to another host, so a bearer token leaks. Use an opener with no redirect handler for authenticated calls.

subject: CI path filters hide test inputs
content: Before adding docs/** or *.md to paths-ignore, grep the tests for file reads: several suites read Markdown fixtures, and a docs-only change to them would skip the tests that read them.

subject: D1 string size cap
content: D1 rejects any single string or row over 2,000,000 bytes. Storing a whole history array in one JSON column works in tests and fails in production once a group gets busy. Keep events as separate rows.

subject: OpenCode deny-all permission rule
content: In OpenCode 2, a deny-all permission rule removes tools from the provider request entirely, and the free Zen models then refuse the request with a 403 tier error rather than running tool-free.

subject: CI template f-string escaping

subject: Durable Object alarm after eviction
content: A Durable Object that sleeps between alarms can be evicted, and the next alarm pays a 5 to 6 second cold start that loads state from storage. Anything time-critical after the alarm needs that budget.

subject: Cloudflare GraphQL analytics has no cursor
content: The Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API returns at most 10,000 groups and has no cursor, and it reports bad queries as an errors array next to a 200. Check errors before trusting an empty result.

content: Restoring a microVM snapshot reuses the saved MAC address, so two restored copies on one bridge fight over the same lease. Regenerate the MAC on restore when running more than one.

content: Commit subjects in kypp are imperative and describe the behaviour change, not the files touched; no conventional-commit prefixes.

subject: BM25 over static embeddings for recall
content: FTS5 BM25 stays the recall ranker: on 1,205 claim-shaped rows, cosine recall with static embeddings lost on every query type including paraphrase, and adds a model to ship. Revisit only with a real paraphrase failure.

content: An in-memory BM25 index doesn't fit kypp's runtimes: the CLI is a new process per call and Durable Objects evict between requests, so the index would be rebuilt nearly every time. Search stays in SQLite FTS5.

subject: Clairic invents dates
